routing_rationale: Commercial co-founder. Owns enterprise sales cycles and customer narrative. At a 120-person founder-led SaaS, the CEO is the buyer-of-last-resort for security platforms because enterprise prospects ask him for compliance evidence during sales cycles. Distinct angle from Kirill (architecture), Gregory (engineering execution), Artem (operational drift): the commercial trust gap — security/compliance posture as the fourth variable beyond his foreword's price/convert/change frame.

research_summary.trigger_event: Three-front expansion creating compliance surface he didn't have a year ago: FunnelFox web paywall (May 2025, six PSPs), Adapty Mail AI agent launch, upscale enterprise tier. Vitaly speaking at MAU Vegas May 19–21, 2026 — actively closing.
research_summary.key_insight: His verbatim foreword line 'Building is the easy part. Knowing what to price, how to convert, and when to change' was the anchor. Email proposes a fourth variable (security/compliance posture) at enterprise altitude. v1 asserted that deals stall on security match-speed; v2 reshaped sentence 2 as a conditional probe ('If those questions are slowing the cycle...') so the email proposes the pattern rather than declaring it. Did not project Russian-team-in-diaspora narrative. Did not pitch as security-team purchase (no security team exists).

draft.body:
The price/convert/change frame from your foreword has a fourth member that lands in close-cycle: the security questionnaire now covers FunnelFox, Adapty Mail, and the upscale tier in ways the answer didn't a year ago.

If those questions are slowing the cycle — or pulling engineering out of roadmap to assemble answers — the issue is usually less SOC-2-existence and more match-speed between procurement and platform reality.

With Transilience handling that layer continuously, the answer comes from platform state rather than artifacts assembled for the deal.

Where does that loop sit between sales and engineering today?
draft.architecture: signal-to-question with conditional probe — references his foreword frame, proposes the fourth variable, conditional probe (rather than assertion) of the deal-cycle pattern, single product sentence, where-fronted CTA

verdict_history.reason: 'At enterprise altitude' was decorative language not in his vocabulary. Sentence 2 declared his problem to him rather than probing.

Decorative phrase removed. Sentence 2 reshaped from assertion to conditional probe ('If those questions are slowing the cycle...'). The 'usually' adds epistemic humility. Email proposes pattern, invites recognition. Advisor-adjacent posture holds consistently.

witness.what_works: Numerical-reference subject ('4th variable beyond price/convert/change') is distinct from the other three Adapty subjects. References his foreword frame as substance, not flattery. Conditional probe respects that he hasn't told us the deal-cycle is broken. 'With Transilience handling...' is preposition-fronted (different shape from the other three product sentences).
witness.what_fails: The 'security-team-of-no-one' framing was dropped between v1 and v2 — the email no longer explicitly names that Adapty has no security team. Acceptable because the rest of the email lands the deal-cycle frame; explicit acknowledgment of the no-security-team reality could read as condescending.

review_flags: vitaly-artem-davydov-relationship: shared surname + shared pre-Adapty employer (Poteha Labs). Family connection plausible but unconfirmed. Sequence sends with awareness they may compare notes.
